self_inflicted_and_recovered_issue.description: manifest/i18n/routes.json's 'home' page entry declares data/book-pagination.json as a canonical-source dependency (content-fingerprint binding). After pass-1 regenerated that file, the recorded source.sha256 went stale, blocking build_site_index.py via localization.py's validate_routes(). Recomputed and wrote the correct source.sha256 using the exact source_hash() algorithm already defined in scripts/localization.py -- but initially left the PL variant's source_sha256 field unchanged, which made effective_status() classify PL's home variant as 'stale' and made site_header()'s switcher render a disabled 'PL unavailable' span on the freshly-regenerated RU homepage instead of a real link. build_polish_course.py's subsequent translation pass then crashed (KeyError: missing PL translation memory entry) trying to translate that never-before-seen 'Przekład niedostępny'-class string, after having already deleted and partially rewritten site/pl/.
self_inflicted_and_recovered_issue.recovery: Restored site/pl/ from git (git checkout -- site/pl/), updated BOTH the source.sha256 and the PL variant's source_sha256 to the same freshly-computed hash (keeping the pair internally consistent), regenerated the RU homepage correctly (real PL link, badge=1767), then re-ran build_polish_course.py successfully end to end (1160/1160 pages, 493 notebooks).
self_inflicted_and_recovered_issue.files_affected_by_the_incident: site/pl/** (fully restored via git checkout, then correctly regenerated); no partial/corrupt state was committed at any point.
